title: Glowing piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='44' ry='22' fill='#1a3a5c' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- piano body -->
  <rect x='14' y='38' width='72' height='34' rx='4' fill='#4a2a1a'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x='14' y='38' width='72' height='6' rx='3' fill='#7a4a2a'/>
  <!-- body top edge -->
  <rect x='14' y='38' width='72' height='3' rx='2' fill='#8a5a3a'/>
  <!-- piano lid -->
  <path d='M14 38 Q14 24 30 26 L70 26 Q86 24 86 38 Z' fill='#5a3020'/>
  <!-- lid highlight -->
  <path d='M20 36 Q22 28 32 28 L50 28 L50 36 Z' fill='#7a4a30' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- glowing keys area -->
  <rect x='20' y='48' width='60' height='18' rx='2' fill='#0a1628'/>
  <!-- white keys -->
  <rect x='22' y='49' width='7' height='16' rx='1' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <rect x='30' y='49' width='7' height='16' rx='1' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <rect x='38' y='49' width='7' height='16' rx='1' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='49' width='7' height='16' rx='1' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <rect x='54' y='49' width='7' height='16' rx='1' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <rect x='62' y='49' width='7' height='16' rx='1' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <rect x='70' y='49' width='8' height='16' rx='1' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <!-- black keys -->
  <rect x='27' y='49' width='4' height='10' rx='1' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='35' y='49' width='4' height='10' rx='1' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='51' y='49' width='4' height='10' rx='1' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='59' y='49' width='4' height='10' rx='1' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='67' y='49' width='4' height='10' rx='1' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <!-- glow on keys -->
  <rect x='22' y='49' width='7' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8fd8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='38' y='49' width='7' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8fd8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='54' y='49' width='7' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8fd8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='70' y='49' width='8' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8fd8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffd966' opacity='0.9'>
    <ellipse cx='58' cy='20' rx='4' ry='3' transform='rotate(-20 58 20)'/>
    <rect x='61' y='8' width='2' height='12' fill='#ffd966'/>
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='26' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' transform='rotate(-20 72 26)'/>
    <rect x='75' y='16' width='1.8' height='10' fill='#ffd966'/>
  </g>
  <!-- glow stars -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='22' r='1.5' fill='#8fd8ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#ffd966' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='16' r='1' fill='#8fd8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='20' y='72' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#4a2a1a'/>
  <rect x='74' y='72' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#4a2a1a'/>
  <!-- leg highlights -->
  <rect x='21' y='72' width='2' height='10' rx='1' fill='#7a4a2a'/>
  <rect x='75' y='72' width='2' height='10' rx='1' fill='#7a4a2a'/>
</svg>
